title: acourtia patens
intro: Acourtia patens, commonly known as yerba quina or fleabane, is a perennial herb native to the Americas. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues. The health benefits of Acourtia patens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Acourtia patens, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antitumor, and cardiovascular protective effects.
